title: SLO Healthboard: Predictive Burn Signals & Stakeholder Playbook
creator: Liam O'Connor
description: Create an SLO Healthboard that combines predictive error-budget burn signals, SLI cohort attribution, and an integrated stakeholder playbook. Deliverables: a unified dashboard for initiative owners, automated triggerable rollout gates (pause/canary-rollback), and templated remediation playbooks that surface in Console and incident runbooks. Goal is to reduce manual triage time for degrading SLOs and ensure consistent cross-team responses when error budgets start to deviate from forecast.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows initiative-level SLI history, current burn rate, and 7/30/90-day Monte Carlo burn probability bands for the next 14 days
Cohort attribution view that filters SLIs by traffic cohorts (region, customer tier, model-version) and highlights top contributors to burn
Automated gate that can pause rollouts or trigger a canary rollback when projected burn probability > 75% within 48 hours, with manual override logged
Stakeholder playbook auto-populated with recommended remediation steps, pager/escalation contacts, and linked artifacts (PRs, runbooks, dashboards)
Playbook templates surfaced in Console rollout UI and included as attachments in incident initiations
Telemetry and alerting tests verifying signal integrity (synthetic SLI injections + golden run), with documented test passes

notes: Trade-offs discussed: aggressive auto-rollback reduces exposure but can cause unnecessary reversions for noisy SLIs. Consensus: conservative default threshold (75% prob within 48h) + manual opt-in for teams that want full automation.
Implementation risk: backfilling cohort tags could be delayed if historical traces lack required metadata. Mitigation: incremental cohort attribution and mark historical gaps in dashboard.
Metrics to monitor post-launch: false-positive rollback rate, mean time to remediation when playbook executed, number of manual overrides, and initiative SLO attainment delta after playbook adoption.
